title: Event Grid from C#
description: Use Event Grid for event routing — publish events from C# and subscribe with webhooks, Service Bus, or Azure Functions.

data.text: Azure Event Grid is a fully managed event routing service. You publish events to a topic, and Event Grid pushes them to subscribed handlers — webhooks, Azure Functions, Service Bus queues, Logic Apps, and more — using a push-based model.

data.title: Install the Azure.Messaging.EventGrid package
data.content:
// Package: Azure.Messaging.EventGrid
dotnet add package Azure.Messaging.EventGrid

data.text: Use EventGridPublisherClient to send events to a custom topic or a system topic. Each event has a required subject, event type, data version, and a JSON data payload.

data.title: BlogEventPublisher.cs — publish blog-post events to Event Grid
CloudEvent schema (recommended for new projects)
items: **id** — unique event ID (Event Grid generates one if omitted)

data.text: Subscribing with an Azure Function Webhook
The simplest subscriber is an HTTP-triggered Azure Function. Event Grid delivers events via POST and validates the endpoint on subscription using a validation handshake.

data.title: HandleBlogEvent.cs — Event Grid webhook subscriber
Event Grid retries aggressively
data.text: Event Grid retries failed deliveries with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours. Ensure your subscriber returns 200 quickly for the validation handshake and handles all event types gracefully — an unhandled exception causes repeated redeliveries.

data.title: Publish and subscribe to a custom event
data.description: Create an Event Grid custom topic, publish a BlobUploaded event, and route it to a Function webhook.
steps: Create an Event Grid custom topic in the Azure portal
Write a BlogEventPublisher that publishes BlobUploaded events
Deploy a HandleBlogEvent Azure Function webhook
Create an Event Grid subscription pointing to the function URL
Send three blob events and confirm the function receives and logs them
data.expectedOutcome: All three events appear in the function log with correct event type and payload.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Event Grid is push-based — subscribers receive events over HTTP webhooks
Use custom topics for application events; system topics for Azure resource events
Handle the validation handshake for new webhook subscriptions
Retry aggressively — return 200 and process events asynchronously
data.takeaway: Event Grid removes the polling overhead from pub-sub architectures, letting you react to Azure and custom events in near real-time.
